data.name: Kashmiri
data.gender_notes: Kashmiri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the region of Kashmir, which means 'desirable land' or 'place of delight'. In Hindu mythology, Kashmir is known as the 'Paradise on Earth'. The name Kashmiri carries the meaning “From Kashmir” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kashmiri usually hope their child will grow to embody from kashmir and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes beauty, serenity, and connection to nature.
data.etymology: Kashmiri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “From Kashmir.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kashmiri total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
